FIRST THE KEY. THEN THE PLAY.

Your RAWG key, step by step.

Create a key in your own RAWG account and connect it here. Your RAWG account is separate from your PlayNext account.

  1. 01

    Open the API page

    Visit RAWG API and click Get API Key. The Free plan is listed for personal and hobby projects. Check the current terms and limits.

  2. 02

    Sign in or create a RAWG account

    Use Log in if you already have an account or Sign up to sign up. Complete registration and confirm your email if RAWG asks you to.

  3. 03

    Request your key in the developer area

    Return to Get API Key after signing in. Fill in the requested details about personal PlayNext use and accept RAWG’s terms if you agree. Copy the key generated by RAWG.

    This area requires sign-in. Screenshots show public pages only; no API key is shown.

  4. 04

    Paste the key into PlayNext

    Sign in to PlayNext to store it encrypted, or use it as a guest in this tab only. Open Connect RAWG, paste your key and select Connect and discover.

YOU’RE IN CONTROL

Your data and privacy.

PlayNext is maintained by SchunckLeonardo. Google authenticates access and links your email to your collection; the RAWG key, choices, and filters help you discover games and manage your collection. We do not ask for your name, national ID, phone number, or address. The app has no ads or analytics.

How we protect data

Google handles sign-in. We do not collect or store your Google password. Supabase Auth links your authenticated identity. The RAWG key, collection, and filters are stored in one authenticated-encrypted document in Supabase Vault. Your email stays in the Auth service, protected by Supabase infrastructure. Production connections use HTTPS. The key and session tokens remain in this tab’s memory; sign in again after signing out or reloading.

Vault protects data at rest. The service must decrypt it for you to use the app; authorized project administrators may access it. This is not end-to-end encryption. Choices from older versions may remain in your browser until you import them; the old key is removed automatically without being read.

Services involved

Google provides sign-in and shares your email and basic profile with Supabase Auth. Supabase provides authentication, database, and Vault in the us-east-1 region (United States). RAWG receives your key and filters in catalog requests. Sites hosting and image/font providers receive normal technical access data, such as your IP address. This involves international data transfer. Providers apply their own policies and technical retention periods.

Retention and your rights

Your data stays in the active database until you remove it or delete your account. In My Account, you can download your data, remove your key, or delete your PlayNext data and identity link. Your Google account remains. You can correct and remove choices in your collection. Deletion removes active data and sessions; provider backups and logs follow their own retention periods and are not immediately deleted by this app.

For other access, correction, or deletion requests, contact the maintainer through the project channel, without posting passwords, keys, or personal data. See the ANPD data subject rights.

This notice describes implemented controls and is not a certification of compliance with Brazil’s LGPD. Last updated: 2026-10-19.
